desc: 169 Mercer Street between Prince and Houston Streets was built in 1895-96 and was designed by John Prague as a warehouse. It is located in the SoHo-Cast Iron Historic District. (Source: "NYCLPC SoHo - Cast-Iron Historic District Designation Report")

title: File:149 Mercer Street.jpg
desc: 149 Mercer Street between Houston and Prince Streets in the SoHo neighborhood of Manhattan, New York City was built in 1826 as a dwelling. It is located within the SoHo-Cast Iron Historic District. (Source: SoHo-Cast Iron Historic District Designation Report)

title: File:105 Mercer Street.jpg
desc: 105 Mercer Street, between Spring and Prince Streets in the SoHo neighborhood of Manhattan, New York City, was built in 1819-20 in the Federal style as a dwelling. (Source: NYCLPC SoHo - Cast Iron Historic District Designation Report)
